seo.title: iCloud Sync and connection sharing for teams
seo.description: Keep connections, groups and tags in step across your Mac, iPhone and iPad with iCloud Sync, share connection files, and publish to your team’s library.

header.title: Sync and sharing
header.lead: Sync connections through iCloud, share them as files, or publish connections and queries to your team.

bands.title: iCloud Sync
text: Sync through a private iCloud database across your Macs, iPhone and iPad, switched on separately on each. On the Mac you choose what goes: connections, groups, settings, SSH and credential profiles, favorites, saved queries and table folders. Passwords sync through iCloud Keychain only if you turn that on too.
notes: Free on iPhone and iPad, for connections, groups and tags. Query history, Data Rewind, password sources and tunnel commands never sync.

bands.title: Share a connection
text: Export a .tablepro file with settings, groups and tags and no passwords, or use Encrypted Export to include them under a passphrase, with AES-256-GCM. Importing either is free, and tablepro://import links carry settings, never passwords.
notes: Encrypted Export is free on iPhone and iPad.

bands.title: Team Catalog and Team Library
text: Team Catalog publishes password-free connection files to a folder you share, and teammates add it as a Linked Folder. Team Library publishes connections and saved queries to TablePro’s server, never passwords: members with a seat pull changes at launch and every 15 minutes, and see who last changed each query.

more.title: Linked Folders
text: Watch a folder of .tablepro files, such as a Git checkout or a shared drive, and the connections follow the files.

more.title: Handoff
text: Continue with the same connection or table on another Apple device, once the connection syncs through iCloud on both.

more.title: Team seats
text: A seat covers one person on up to {deviceLimit} computers, Mac or Linux. Owners and admins invite people by email from the account portal.

more.title: On iPhone and iPad
text: Sync connections through iCloud, continue with Handoff, and import or export .tablepro files.
